The collector now serves embedded teams — measured on real projects.

**New**

- **Zephyr workspaces**: `west.yml` is read directly — a real workspace
  scan finds all 80 modules with their pinned revisions.
- **Yocto and Buildroot build output**: run the check in your BUILD
  directory; it reads `deploy/images/**/*.manifest` (verified against a
  real yocto-6.0.2 image manifest: 1,032 packages) and
  `legal-info/manifest.csv` (verified against a real `make legal-info`
  output). The build output is what is actually in your image.
- **Honest message instead of an empty run**: if no supported build
  system is found, nothing is uploaded — the tool lists what it
  recognises and points Yocto/Buildroot users to the build directory.

**Fixed**

- Component identity is (name, version, ecosystem): nested second
  versions of one npm package are kept as own rows — the older nested
  version is often the vulnerable one.
- Build tools and system libraries (`Doxygen`, `anl`, `Git`, …) no
  longer appear as product components (curated 950-name skip list;
  your own `jochwacht-deps.yaml` declarations are never skipped).
- A make `-ln -s` line no longer produces a component named "n", and
  `-lpaho-mqtt3c` is no longer truncated to "paho".
- `*` is never reported as a version — a missing version is honestly
  missing.
